# ChIP-seq Validation Contract

## Simulation Truth

- Reference/annotation source, target regulatory elements, true peak intervals,
  binding affinity, fragment/read settings, ChIP versus input assignment,
  differential-binding effects, background/noise model, and seed.

## Required Results

- True-peak BED/TSV, read manifest/positions or FASTQ, sample metadata,
  peak-count table, differential-binding truth, QC TSV/JSON, and a parameter manifest.

## Required Figures

- Peak locations over promoters/enhancers or genome track.
- Peak-centred ChIP versus input enrichment profile.
- FRiP/library-complexity/QC plots.
- Differential-binding recovery plot when conditions are simulated.

## Pass Criteria

- Peak intervals are valid, sorted, and inside reference contig bounds.
- ChIP and input samples, read counts, and condition labels agree with metadata.
- Programmed target regions have greater simulated enrichment than background;
  report the selected summary rather than assuming a fixed FRiP cutoff.
- Differential-binding calls are benchmarked against retained peak truth.
